title: display and edit methods: the modifier that will not combine with static, and the per-row cost
instruction: In the sandbox model, add two computed columns to the standard CustGroup table. An AxTableExtension carries no <Methods> element at all, so display and edit methods on a table you do not own go in an [ExtensionOf(tableStr(CustGroup))] final class; writing them into a table extension FAILS this case. Ground it first with get_knowledge(topic="display-edit-methods"). (1) A DISPLAY method returning an EDT-typed value computed from the record. It must carry [SysClientCacheDataMethodAttribute(true)], because a display method runs once per VISIBLE ROW on every refresh and this one only changes with the record. (2) An EDIT method with the signature `edit <T> name(boolean _set, <T> _value)`: _set is false while the form paints and true when the user commits, and the method returns the value to show. Neither may be static - `display static` is a compile error ("Conflicting modifiers 'static display'"), and writing it that way FAILS this case. Neither may be used in a select where clause: they are X++, not SQL. The extension must build with zero errors and zero BP errors.
